shortDescription: Brazilian pulp maker Suzano BMFBOVESPA:SUZB3 will increase pulp prices in October by $50 per metric ton in Europe and the Americas, and by $20 per ton in Asia, the company said on Tuesday, confirming a previous report by Reuters.

children: will increase pulp prices in October by $50 per metric ton in Europe and the Americas, and by $20 per ton in Asia, the company said on Tuesday, confirming a previous report by Reuters.
The increase in Europe will leave prices in the region at $1,360 per ton.
Suzano's price hike for Asia follows a previous increase this month, which was the first one implemented by the company for the region since April.
Shares in Suzano were up some 2.4% in the afternoon, one of the main gains among stocks from Brazil's benchmark equity index Bovespa
